definition: Ashish Vaswani is an Indian computer scientist and entrepreneur.
details: He conducted research at Google Brain, co-founded Adept AI, and co-founder and chief executive officer of Essential AI. As of June 2026, Vaswani, along with Essential AI, was acqui-hired by Nvidia. Vaswani is a co-author of the 2017 paper "Attention Is All You Need", which introduced the Transformer neural network architecture. The Transformer model has been used in the development of subsequent NLP models BERT, ChatGPT, and their successors.
